posts.title: Medical Officer — Inspectorate of Prisons (transfer on deputation)
posts.qualifications: Official holding an analogous post under Directorate of Health Services or Goa Medical College.
posts.language: No post-specific language requirement stated in advertisement.

posts.title: Assistant Engineer (Electrical) — Goa Dental College (transfer on deputation)
posts.qualifications: Officer of Central or State Government holding an analogous regular post, or three years' regular service in the specified pay scale or equivalent; Electrical Engineering degree or equivalent and three years' maintenance/repair experience with dental machinery and equipment.
posts.language: No post-specific language requirement stated in advertisement.

posts.title: Assistant Professor, Radio Diagnosis — Goa Medical College (transfer on deputation)
posts.qualifications: Officer under Central, State or Union Territory government holding an analogous post. Deputation ordinarily does not exceed three years.
posts.language: No post-specific language requirement stated in advertisement.

posts.title: Lecturer in General Medicine — Goa Medical College
posts.qualifications: Recognised medical qualification under the cited Indian Medical Council Act schedules; recognised postgraduate degree or equivalent in General Medicine; at least three years in relevant senior residency/registrar/tutor/demonstrator role after postgraduate degree; knowledge of Konkani. Age not exceeding 45 years, subject to applicable relaxation.
posts.language: Konkani essential; general instructions assess at least working knowledge at interview. Government may relax this for professional-college posts on Commission recommendation where suitable Konkani-speaking candidates are unavailable. Marathi desirable.

posts.title: Dietician — Directorate of Health Services
posts.qualifications: Degree in Home Science from recognised university or equivalent; knowledge of Konkani. Age not exceeding 45 years, subject to applicable relaxation. Dietetics/nutrition qualifications, hospital experience and Marathi are desirable.
posts.language: Konkani essential; general instructions assess at least working knowledge at interview. Marathi desirable.

posts.title: Scientific Assistant, Toxicology, Chemistry and Narcotics — Forensic Science Laboratory
posts.qualifications: Second-class Master's in Science from recognised university, specialising in Chemistry or Forensic Science; knowledge of Konkani. Age not exceeding 45 years, subject to applicable relaxation. Computer literacy and Marathi are desirable.
posts.language: Konkani essential; general instructions assess at least working knowledge at interview. Marathi desirable.

posts.title: Scientific Assistant, Biology and Serology — Forensic Science Laboratory
posts.qualifications: Second-class Master's in Science from recognised university, specialising in Zoology, Forensic Science, Microbiology, Genetics or Biotechnology; knowledge of Konkani. Age not exceeding 45 years, subject to applicable relaxation. Computer literacy and Marathi are desirable.
posts.language: Konkani essential; general instructions assess at least working knowledge at interview. Marathi desirable.
